targets.rawSql: WITH bounds AS ( SELECT p.start_time AS effective_start, p.end_time AS effective_end FROM partitions p WHERE (COALESCE(array_length(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[],1),0) = 0 OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[])) ), granularity AS ( SELECT GREATEST($__interval_ms::double precision, 1) AS step_ms ) SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / granularity.step_ms) * granularity.step_ms / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(pack.hv_pack_v) AS "hvc/hv_pack_v [V]", AVG(pack.hv_c) AS "hvc/hv_c [A]", AVG(pack.hv_soc) AS "hvc/hv_soc [%]" FROM pack JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = pack.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true JOIN granularity ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;

WITH bounds AS ( SELECT p.start_time AS effective_start, p.end_time AS effective_end FROM partitions p WHERE (COALESCE(array_length(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[],1),0) = 0 OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[])) ), granularity AS ( SELECT GREATEST($__interval_ms::double precision, 1) AS step_ms ), cell_v AS (SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / granularity.step_ms) * granularity.step_ms / 1000.0) AS time, UNNEST(pack.cells_v) AS value FROM pack JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = pack.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true JOIN granularity ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end) SELECT time, AVG(value) FILTER (WHERE value > 0) AS "hvc/cells_v_avg [V]", MIN(value) FILTER (WHERE value > 0) AS "hvc/cells_v_min [V]", MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE value > 0) AS "hvc/cells_v_max [V]" FROM cell_v GROUP BY time ORDER BY time;

WITH bounds AS ( SELECT p.start_time AS effective_start, p.end_time AS effective_end FROM partitions p WHERE (COALESCE(array_length(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[],1),0) = 0 OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[])) ), granularity AS ( SELECT GREATEST($__interval_ms::double precision, 1) AS step_ms ), cell_t AS (SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / granularity.step_ms) * granularity.step_ms / 1000.0) AS time, UNNEST(pack.cells_temps) AS value FROM pack JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = pack.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true JOIN granularity ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end), thermal_t AS (SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / granularity.step_ms) * granularity.step_ms / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(thermal.cell_top_temp) AS cell_top_temp, AVG(thermal.cell_bottom_temp) AS cell_bottom_temp, AVG(thermal.bus_bar_temp1) AS bus_bar_temp1, AVG(thermal.bus_bar_temp2) AS bus_bar_temp2, AVG(thermal.bus_bar_temp3) AS bus_bar_temp3 FROM thermal JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = thermal.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true JOIN granularity ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1), diag_t AS (SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / granularity.step_ms) * granularity.step_ms / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(diagnostics_low.precharge_r_temp) AS precharge_r_temp FROM diagnostics_low JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = diagnostics_low.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true JOIN granularity ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1) SELECT cell_t.time, AVG(cell_t.value) AS "hvc/cells_temp_avg [C]", MIN(cell_t.value) AS "hvc/cells_temp_min [C]", MAX(cell_t.value) AS "hvc/cells_temp_max [C]", MAX(thermal_t.cell_top_temp) AS "hvc/cell_top_temp [C]", MAX(thermal_t.cell_bottom_temp) AS "hvc/cell_bottom_temp [C]", MAX(thermal_t.bus_bar_temp1) AS "hvc/bus_bar_temp1 [C]", MAX(thermal_t.bus_bar_temp2) AS "hvc/bus_bar_temp2 [C]", MAX(thermal_t.bus_bar_temp3) AS "hvc/bus_bar_temp3 [C]", MAX(diag_t.precharge_r_temp) AS "hvc/precharge_r_temp [C]" FROM cell_t LEFT JOIN thermal_t ON thermal_t.time = cell_t.time LEFT JOIN diag_t ON diag_t.time = cell_t.time GROUP BY cell_t.time ORDER BY cell_t.time;

WITH bounds AS ( SELECT p.start_time AS effective_start, p.end_time AS effective_end FROM partitions p WHERE (COALESCE(array_length(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[],1),0) = 0 OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[])) ), granularity AS ( SELECT GREATEST($__interval_ms::double precision, 1) AS step_ms ) SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / granularity.step_ms) * granularity.step_ms / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(diagnostics_high.hvc_state_machine) AS "hvc/hvc_state_machine [state]", AVG(CASE WHEN diagnostics_high.pos_hv_contactor THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "hvc/pos_hv_contactor [bool]", AVG(CASE WHEN diagnostics_high.neg_hv_contactor THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "hvc/neg_hv_contactor [bool]", AVG(CASE WHEN diagnostics_high.precharge_contactor THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "hvc/precharge_contactor [bool]", AVG(CASE WHEN diagnostics_low.bmb_comm_error THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "hvc/bmb_comm_error [bool]", AVG(CASE WHEN diagnostics_low.imd_gnd_isolation_error THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "hvc/imd_gnd_isolation_error [bool]", AVG(CASE WHEN diagnostics_low.shutdown_leg1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "hvc/shutdown_leg1 [bool]", AVG(CASE WHEN diagnostics_low.shutdown_leg2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "hvc/shutdown_leg2 [bool]", AVG(CASE WHEN diagnostics_low.shutdown_leg3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "hvc/shutdown_leg3 [bool]", AVG(CASE WHEN diagnostics_low.shutdown_leg4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "hvc/shutdown_leg4 [bool]" FROM packet JOIN bounds ON true JOIN granularity ON true LEFT JOIN diagnostics_high ON diagnostics_high.packet_id = packet.packet_id LEFT JOIN diagnostics_low ON diagnostics_low.packet_id = packet.packet_id WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;
